static_axes.cfg: All conditional and unconditional transfers mapped individually. Length scan line 211; row render loop 259; interaction loop 279; key retry 308/343; alpha search 355; disabled-item retry 341-343.
static_axes.constants: Mapped control constants: 4000 allocation; maxLen+1 buffer stride; geometry margins 16,5,6,3; '-' separator; 0x80 disabled mask; -1 sentinels; 0x0800 extended key; 10/13/0x20 done keys; 27 Escape; '+',0x0850,'-',0x0848 navigation; 0x0852/0x0853 done; retry 16; uppercase delta 0x20; event byte 0xFE; close constants 0x30,4,0x2FF. Remaining arithmetic immediates in the full disassembly correspond to the same source literals/expressions.
static_axes.width_signedness: 16-bit large-model int, 8-bit signed char, far pointers as offset:segment word pairs. Signed Jcc for int comparisons; equality on bit patterns; TEST for masks; p/buf guard is unsigned 16-bit offset comparison within the same allocation. CBW/CWD alias verification is recorded above.
static_axes.pointer_math: item table stride 4 per far pointer; rendered row stride maxLen+1; byte indexing for chars; Pt/Rect passed by far address; buffer bound compares offset after +4000; saved surface pointer preserved far.
static_axes.calls_abi_order: All 42 lcall instructions in original-PC order with target, source anchor, arguments, return shape and caller cleanup. Large-model far C calls use right-to-left stack arguments; far pointers occupy four bytes and ints two bytes.
static_axes.observable_effects: Direct writes are g_5AAC save/clear/restore and caller selection byte. Ordered helper/CRT calls preserve allocation, drawing, input consumption, event forwarding, and error-reporting effects. Empty-list path bypasses allocation and normal cleanup.

remaining_differences.explanation: Single-function diagnostics show frame/stack-slot/register allocation, branch destination/layout, call-frame and instruction-selection differences (386 exact instructions, 76 anchors, 75 mismatch islands). They also leave 362 residual observations ungrouped and label some local code generation unclassified; that is byte-localization debt, not an independent semantic verdict. Full target branch edges, calls, operations and effects are mapped to source above, with no divergent condition or target-only observable effect found. This remains a historical byte/extent mismatch and is not promoted.

run.summary: 53 directed plus 100 randomized cases, 153 executed; 0 errors/mismatches; original and candidate actually executed.

limits: Finite deterministic/fixed-seed domain only; not universal proof.
Host driver, BIOS/input scheduling, arbitrary RTLink overlay sequences, and full framebuffer are outside the contract.
Fixture requires valid far pointers, NUL strings, a valid 4000-byte Ralloc block and deterministic input/mouse/timer/display sinks.
Differential evidence corroborates but does not substitute for the static mapping.

root_review.basis: Reviewed the whole-function branch/call/state/width maps, source/evidence identities, explanations of residue and differential/negative limits. Matching observed service boundaries are composed through the actual caller ABI and same callee/slot/state; finite coverage alone is not acceptance.

promotion: Reviewed definition imported once into canonical whole TU; historical declarations, types and private data retained. Builds do not read the prior candidate or this receipt.
